name: filow-monorepo
description: Filow: a live speaking companion that listens as you present, checks off your talking points as you cover them and shows what you missed.
author: Stefan Butnaru

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,session -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/powerpoint && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/browser
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/powerpoint && npm run typecheck -w apps/browser && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w apps/desktop
